notes: Rain can make the trail slippery, while heat and sun exposure materially raise the effort; the long trail has little shelter and running water can create wet-season hazards.
The 485 m memorial walk takes about 40–50 minutes return and needs moderate fitness.
The 2.6 km return trail can take up to three hours, includes steep climbs and descents, and requires high fitness plus a safety radio.
A car or driver gives the most reliable timing; public buses take longer and schedules may not be precise.
Nam Tok railway station is about 20 km away and there is no taxi service from the centre to the station, so rail connections require separate planning.
